title: Directory brute force
description: Discover hidden paths. Add -x php,txt,html to probe extensions.
output: Paths with status codes (200, 301, 403). 403 often means it exists but is protected.

title: Virtual host / subdomain discovery
description: Finds virtual hosts served from the same IP. Set the domain in /etc/hosts first.
output: Discovered vhosts that return a different response size than the baseline.

title: Parameter fuzzing
description: Discover hidden GET parameters. -fs filters by response size to cut noise.
output: Parameter names that change the response, worth testing for injection.

title: Recursive content discovery
description: Recursive by default, so it walks into directories it finds. Fast and thorough.
output: Tree of discovered paths with status and size, recursing automatically.

title: Directory brute force (follow redirects)
description: Verbose dir brute with 100 threads: -e prints full URLs, --no-error hides errors, -r follows redirects, -o saves the results.
output: Full URLs with status codes, redirects followed automatically.

title: SMB / Samba enumeration
description: All-in-one SMB enum: shares, users, groups, password policy, OS info.
output: Domain info, share list, user accounts and the password policy if readable.

title: Classic SMB enumeration
description: The original all-in-one SMB/Samba enum. Use -U for users only, -S for shares only, -a for everything.
output: Workgroup/domain info, user list, shares and password policy when readable.

title: SMB share and access check
description: Null-session share listing. Swap in creds to see what an account can reach.
output: Shares with READ/WRITE flags per share for the supplied credentials.

title: Validate credentials across hosts
description: Modern crackmapexec successor (nxc). Sprays creds across a host list and flags where they work, (Pwn3d!) marks local admin.
output: Per-host auth result; (Pwn3d!) means admin access, blank means valid but not admin.

title: List SMB shares
description: Enumerate shares and your READ/WRITE access with the given account. Prefix with proxychains4 -q to run through a pivot.
output: Share names with per-share READ/WRITE permissions.

title: Harvest credentials (SAM/LSA/LSASS)
description: With admin creds, dump SAM hashes and LSA secrets (cached domain creds / DCC2). Add -M lsassy to pull logged-on plaintext from LSASS.
output: Local NTLM hashes plus DCC2/mscash2 (hashcat mode 2100); lsassy can give cleartext.

title: Anonymous LDAP dump
description: Anonymous bind against a domain controller. Often leaks users and descriptions.
output: Directory objects. Check description fields for passwords left by admins.

title: Enumerate users via OID
description: Walk a specific OID (this one lists user accounts) over SNMP v1 with the default 'public' community.
output: SNMP-exposed usernames when the community string is valid.

title: Full SNMP walk
description: Dump everything readable over SNMP. Install snmp-mibs-downloader so numeric OIDs translate to names.
output: System info, processes, routes and network config, sometimes credentials.

title: Automated SNMP enumeration
description: Friendlier, structured SNMP enumeration. The 'manager'/'private' communities often allow writes.
output: Organized report of system, network, users and running software.

title: Write via manager community
description: Manager/private communities frequently allow writes. Change an SNMP value to prove impact, then read it back with snmpwalk.
output: Confirms the value changed, proof of write access over SNMP.

title: Brute-force SNMP communities
description: Fast scanner to find valid SNMP community strings from a list (seclists ships good ones under SNMP).
output: Valid community strings per host, feed them into snmpwalk/snmp-check.
